chunks: So leave Me and those who deny this Discourse. We shall lead them step by step to (ruin) in a way they will not know.

key_terms.سَنَسْتَدْرِجُهُمْ: We shall lead them step by step (Istidraj)
key_terms.مِنْ حَيْثُ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ: from where they do not know

ai.seo_question: What does the concept of Istidraj (gradual leading into ruin) mean in the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the concept of *istidrāj* (gradual seduction), where God grants respite to disbelievers not as mercy, but as a means to deepen their arrogance until they are caught unawares. It serves as a theological counterpoint to divine justice, illustrating how apparent worldly success can mask spiritual decline. The verse underscores the Prophet's patience amidst rejection, affirming that ultimate retribution is inevitable and precisely timed by God.
